name: Brofaromine
summary: Brofaromine (proposed brand name Consonar) is a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA) discovered by Ciba-Geigy. The compound was primarily researched in the treatment of depression and anxiety but its development was dropped before it was brought to market.

pharmacology.text: Brofaromine is a reversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase A (RIMA, a type of monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI)) and acts on epinephrine (adrenaline), norepinephrine (noradrenaline), serotonin, and dopamine. Unlike standard MAOIs, possible side effects do not include cardiovascular complications (hypertension) with encephalopathy, liver toxicity or hyperthermia.
pharmacology.kind: Monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI); Reversible inhibitor of MAO-A (RIMA)

uses.text: The compound was primarily researched in the treatment of depression and anxiety but its development was dropped before it was brought to market.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects included nausea, sleeplessness and dizziness. As a drug that raises serotonin, it carries a risk of serotonin syndrome, with fever, stiffness and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應包括噁心、失眠與頭暈。作為提高血清素的藥物，它有血清素症候群的風險，會出現發燒、肌肉僵硬與混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应包括恶心、失眠与头晕。作为提高血清素的药物，它有血清素症候群的风险，会出现发烧、肌肉僵硬与混乱。

fact.en: It was a reversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor, meaning it lets go of the enzyme instead of destroying it. That was meant to remove the need for a strict diet, but its development was dropped anyway.
fact.zh: 它是可逆性單胺氧化酶抑制劑，意思是它會從酵素上鬆開，而非將其破壞。這原本是為了免除嚴格飲食限制，但它的開發最終仍被放棄。
fact.zhHans: 它是可逆性单胺氧化酶抑制剂，意思是它会从酵素上松开，而非将其破坏。这原本是为了免除严格饮食限制，但它的开发最终仍被放弃。
